summary.name: Dropshelf
summary.one_liner: Dropshelf is a macOS drag and drop helper app that places shelves on screen edges for holding files, currently offered as a free beta after being pulled from the Mac App Store.
use_cases: hold files while dragging between windows on a Mac
drag files into apps from a screen-edge shelf
use a drag and drop helper on multiple monitors
try a free beta macOS utility without a trial limit
summary.what_it_does: Dropshelf is a drag and drop helper for macOS that provides shelves where files can be dropped and held. Shelves can be created at any screen edge, including edges between monitors, and can be moved anywhere on screen by dragging their background. The June 2021 build is a universal binary for Apple silicon and Intel, with a refreshed look that adapts to light and dark mode. The current beta (Build 1729) is fully functional with trial limits removed.
notable: Universal binary for Apple silicon and Intel, M1-optimized
Shelves can be created at any screen edge, including between monitors
Beta build is fully functional with no time or trial limits
Sold on the Mac App Store from 2012 to 2021, then removed from sale
caveats: Removed from Mac App Store sale in 2021; the author plans to release an update there when time allows
User interface is English only for this build; other languages are planned for a future update
